==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>UserFilm|{{Var|number}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code> into your user page, where <code>{{Var|number}}</code> is either a Roman numeral I&ndash;IX or an Arabic number 1&ndash;9. There is no difference between using a Roman numeral such as <code>IV</code> or its Arabic numeral equivalent <code>4</code>.
